verdict.rationale: Obsidian's own architecture keeps notes as local plain-text Markdown on the user's device, and Sync is end-to-end encrypted by default, so 'not even the Obsidian team' can access notes. This structurally keeps vendor-side training on user data off the table, but the evidence contains no explicit AI-training policy or opt-out. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that user data is never used for AI training, a documented training opt-out or policy, and independent corroboration.
